sv.title: Ida Gabrielsson (V) efter C:s val: ”Ska ingå i regeringen”
sv.summary: Centerpartiet väljer Magdalena Anderssons totalpaket. Då återupprepar V sina regeringskrav. – Beskedet att vi ska ingå i regeringen, ligger fast, säger vice partiledare Ida Gabrielsson till SVT.

en.title: Ida Gabrielsson (V) after the Centre Party's choice: "Will be part of the government"
en.summary: The Centre Party chooses Magdalena Andersson's package deal. The Left Party then reiterates its government demands. – The message that we will be part of the government stands, says deputy party leader Ida Gabrielsson to SVT.
